name: zreader_read_string
description: zReader_ReadString reads a length-prefixed string from an opened file, allocates a trailing-NUL buffer, stores it in the output value, and returns the bytes read.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob1 /MD /GX /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for @zReader_ReadString@8 at 0x4a6110 passed with zero unmasked mismatches after masking 12 COFF relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 118 bytes and the VC object symbol is 128 bytes with 10 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4a6110 validates reading a 4-byte string length, accumulating the bytes-read count, allocating length + 1 bytes, storing the buffer in the output value, zero-filling the whole buffer, conditionally reading string bytes when length is positive, and returning the total bytes read.
Native archive-backed and retail ZRDR smokes parse string nodes through zReader_ReadNode, including the fixture SYNTAX name and retail SOUND_PATH/FONTS strings.
